G2901.def: from «2900»; to empower, i.e. (passively) increase in vigor:--be strengthened, be (wax) strong.

G2902.def: from «2904»; to use strength, i.e. seize or retain (literally or figuratively):--hold (by, fast), keep, lay hand (hold) on, obtain, retain, take (by).

G2903.def: superlative of a derivative of «2904»; strongest, i.e. (in dignity) very honorable:--most excellent (noble).

G2904.def: perhaps a primary word; vigor ("great") (literally or figuratively):--dominion, might(-ily), power, strength.

G2906.def: from «2896»; an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief):--clamour, cry(-ing).

G2908.et: neuter of an alternate form of (2909)
G2908.def: neuter of an alternate form of «2909»; (as noun) better, i.e. greater advantage:--better.

G2909.def: comparative of a derivative of «2904»; stronger, i.e. (figuratively) better, i.e. nobler:--best, better.

G2910.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb
G2910.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to hang:--hang.

G2911.def: from «2910»; overhanging, i.e. a precipice:--steep place.

G2912.def: from «2914»; a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete:--Crete, Cretian.

G2913.def: of Latin origin; growing; Cresces (i.e. Crescens), a Christian:--Crescens.

G2914.def: of uncertain derivation; Crete, an island in the Mediterranean:--Crete.

G2917.def: from «2919»; a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime")):--avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment.

G2918.def: perhaps a prim word; a lily:--lily.

G2919.def: properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially); by implication, to try, condemn, punish:--avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think.

G2920.def: decision (subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension, a tribunal; by implication, justice (especially, divine law):--accusation, condemnation, damnation, judgment.

G2921.def: of Latin origin; "crisp"; Crispus, a Corinthian:--Crispus.

G2922.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2923»; a rule of judging ("criterion"), i.e. (by implication) a tribunal:--to judge, judgment (seat).

G2923.def: from «2919»; a judge (genitive case or specially):--judge.

G2925.def: apparently a primary verb; to rap:--knock.

G2926.def: feminine of «2927»; a hidden place, i.e. cellar ("crypt"):--secret.

G2927.def: from «2928»; concealed, i.e. private:--hid(-den), inward(-ly), secret.

G2928.def: a primary verb; to conceal (properly, by covering):--hide (self), keep secret, secret(-ly).

G2929.def: from «2930»; to make (i.e. intransitively, resemble) ice ("crystallize"):--be clear as crystal.

G2930.def: from a derivative of kruos (frost); ice, i.e. (by analogy) rock "crystal":--crystal.

G2932.def: a primary verb; to get, i.e. acquire (by any means; own):--obtain, possess, provide, purchase.

G2934.def: from «2932»; property, i.e. (specially) a domestic animal:--beast.

G2936.et: probably akin to (2932) (through the idea of proprietor-ship of the manufacturer)
G2936.def: probably akin to «2932» (through the idea of proprietorship of the manufacturer); to fabricate, i.e. found (form originally):--create, Creator, make.

G2937.def: from «2936»; original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively):--building, creation, creature, ordinance.

G2938.def: from «2936»; an original formation (concretely), i.e. product (created thing):--creature.

G2939.def: from «2936»; a founder, i.e. God (as author of all things):--Creator.

G2940.et: from kubos (a "cube", i.e. die for playing)
G2940.def: from kubos (a "cube", i.e. die for playing); gambling, i.e. (figuratively) artifice or fraud:--sleight.

G2941.et: from kubernao (of Latin origin, to steer)
G2941.def: from kubernao (of Latin origin, to steer); pilotage, i.e. (figuratively) directorship (in the church):--government.

G2942.def: from the same as «2941»; helmsman, i.e. (by implication) captain:--(ship) master.

G2943.def: adverb from the same as «2945»; from the circle, i.e. all around:--(round) about.

G2944.def: from the same as «2945»; to encircle, i.e. surround:--compass (about), come (stand) round about.

G2945.et: as if dative case of kuklos (a ring, "cycle" - akin to (2947))
G2945.def: as if dative case of kuklos (a ring, "cycle"; akin to «2947»); i.e. in a circle (by implication, of «1722»), i.e. (adverbially) all around:--round about.

G2946.def: from «2947»; a wallow (the effect of rolling), i.e. filth:--wallowing.

G2947.et: from base of (2949) (through the idea of circularity, cf (2945), (1507))
G2947.def: from the base of «2949» (through the idea of circularity; compare «2945», «1507»); to roll about:--wallow.

G2948.def: from the same as «2947»; rocking about, i.e. crippled (maimed, in feet or hands):--maimed.

G2949.et: from kuo (to swell [with young], i.e bend, curve)
G2949.def: from kuo (to swell (with young), i.e. bend, curve); a billow (as bursting or toppling):--wave.

G2950.et: from a derivative of the base of (2949)
G2950.def: from a derivative of the base of «2949»; a "cymbal" (as hollow):--cymbal.

G2951.def: of foreign origin (compare «03646»); dill or fennel ("cummin"):--cummin.

G2952.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «2965»; a puppy:--dog.

G2953.def: from «2954»; a Cyprian (Cypriot), i.e. inhabitant of Cyprus:--of Cyprus.

G2954.def: of uncertain origin; Cyprus, an island in the Mediterranean:--Cyprus.

G2955.def: probably from the base of «2949»; to bend forward:--stoop (down).

G2956.def: from «2957»; i.e. Cyrenaean, i.e. inhabitant of Cyrene:--of Cyrene, Cyrenian.

G2957.def: of uncertain derivation; Cyrene, a region of Africa:--Cyrene.

G2958.def: of Latin origin; Cyrenius (i.e. Quirinus), a Roman:--Cyrenius.

G2959.def: feminine of «2962»; Cyria, a Christian woman:--lady.

G2960.def: from «2962»; belonging to the Lord (Jehovah or Jesus):--Lord's.

G2961.def: from «2962»; to rule:--have dominion over, lord, be lord of, exercise lordship over.

G2962.def: from kuros (supremacy); supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title):-- God, Lord, master, Sir.

G2963.def: from «2962»; mastery, i.e. (concretely and collectively) rulers:--dominion, government.

G2964.def: from the same as «2962»; to make authoritative, i.e. ratify:--confirm.

G2965.def: a primary word; a dog ("hound") (literally or figuratively):--dog.

G2966.def: from the base of «2849»; a limb of the body (as if lopped):--carcase.

G2967.def: from the base of «2849»; to estop, i.e. prevent (by word or act):--forbid, hinder, keep from, let, not suffer, withstand.

G2968.def: from «2749»; a hamlet (as if laid down):--town, village.

G2970.def: from «2749»; a carousal (as if letting loose):--revelling, rioting.

G2971.et: apparently a derivative of the base of (2759) and a derivative of (3700)
G2971.def: apparently a derivative of the base of «2759» and a derivative of «3700»; a mosquito (from its stinging proboscis):--gnat.

G2972.def: of uncertain origin; Cos, an island in the Mediterranean:--Cos.

G2973.def: of Hebrew origin (compare «07081»); Cosam (i.e. Kosam) an Israelite:--Cosam.

G2974.def: from «2875»; blunted, i.e. (figuratively) of hearing (deaf) or speech (dumb):--deaf, dumb, speechless.

G2975.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses
G2975.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses; to lot, i.e. determine (by implication, receive) especially by lot:--his lot be, cast lots, obtain.

G2976.def: probably of Hebrew origin («0499»); Lazarus (i.e. Elazar), the name of two Israelites (one imaginary):--Lazarus.

G2978.def: of uncertain derivation; a whirlwind (squall):--storm, tempest.

G2980.et: a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb
G2980.def: a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb; to talk, i.e. utter words:--preach, say, speak (after), talk, tell, utter. Compare «3004».

G2982.def: or lamma lam-mah'; of Hebrew origin (4100 with prepositional prefix); lama (i.e. why):--lama.

G2983.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is use only as an alternate in certain tenses
G2983.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is use only as an alternate in certain tenses; to take (in very many applications, literally and figuratively (properly objective or active, to get hold of; whereas «1209» is rather subjective or passive, to have offered to one; while «138» is more violent, to seize or remove)):--accept, + be amazed, assay, attain, bring, × when I call, catch, come on (X unto), + forget, have, hold, obtain, receive (X after), take (away, up).

G2984.def: of Hebrew origin («03929»); Lamech (i.e. Lemek), a patriarch:--Lamech.

G2985.def: from «2989»; a "lamp" or flambeau:--lamp, light, torch.

G2986.def: from the same as «2985»; radiant; by analogy, limpid; figuratively, magnificent or sumptuous (in appearance):--bright, clear, gay, goodly, gorgeous, white.

G2988.def: adverb from «2986»; brilliantly, i.e. figuratively, luxuriously:--sumptuously.

G2989.def: a primary verb; to beam, i.e. radiate brilliancy (literally or figuratively):--give light, shine.

G2990.et: a prolonged form of a primitive verb, which is used only as an alt. in certain tenses
G2990.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is used only as an alternate in certain tenses; to lie hid (literally or figuratively); often used adverbially, unwittingly:--be hid, be ignorant of, unawares.

G2991.et: from a compound of las (a stone) and the base of (3584) (in its original sense of scraping)
G2991.def: from a compound of las (a stone) and the base of «3584» (in its original sense of scraping); rock-quarried:--hewn in stone.

G2992.def: apparently a primary word; a people (in general; thus differing from «1218», which denotes one's own populace):--people.

G2993.def: from a compound of «2992» and «1349»; Laodicia, a place in Asia Minor:--Laodicea.

G2994.def: from «2993»; a Laodicean, i.e. inhabitant of Laodicia:--Laodicean.

G2996.def: of uncertain origin; Lasaea, a place in Crete:--Lasea.

G2997.et: a strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as alternate in certain tenses
G2997.def: a strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as alternate in certain tenses; to crack open (from a fall):--burst asunder.

G2998.et: from the same as the first part of (2991) and the base of (5114)
G2998.def: from the same as the first part of «2991» and the base of «5114»; to quarry:--hew.

G2999.def: from «3000»; ministration of God, i.e. worship:--(divine) service.
